title: Tai Chi/Qigong Exercise Persistence Among Residents of Senior Housing
brief_summary: This randomized field trial uses a self-report daily exercise log to answer the research question: Does frequency of instruction influence tai chi/qigong home practice exercise persistence among residents of Senior housing?
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Resident of Senior housing,
* Ability to engage in mild exercise
* Vision sufficient to view TV medium
* Willingness to engage in tai chi/qigong training and practice.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to provide informed consent
* Unable to attend initial training session
